known_facts_book1: Owns the garden Peter's mother forbids her children from entering.
Grows lettuces, French beans, radishes, parsley, cabbages, potatoes and onions in the garden.
Killed Peter's father, who 'had an accident' in the garden and was made into a pie — by Mrs. McGregor, not by him directly.
Is on his hands and knees planting out young cabbages near a cucumber frame when he first spots Peter.
Jumps up and chases Peter, waving a rake and calling out 'Stop thief!'
Comes after Peter in the tool-shed with a sieve, intending to pop it over him.
Is after Peter again the moment he hears him sneeze, but Peter jumps out of a window too small for McGregor to follow.
Gives up and goes back to his work once Peter escapes through the window.
Fills his water-cans at a pond where a white cat sits watching goldfish.
Is last seen hoeing onions with his back turned, right before Peter makes his final dash for the gate.
Catches sight of Peter at the corner as Peter slips under the gate, but does not catch him.
Hangs up Peter's abandoned little jacket and shoes for a scare-crow, to frighten the blackbirds.

known_relations_book1.Peter: Chases him the length of the garden with a rake and a sieve; never catches him.
known_relations_book1.Mrs. Rabbit: Told the children of her husband's death in his garden, made into a pie by Mrs. McGregor.
known_relations_book1.Mrs. McGregor: His wife; made Peter's father into a pie. Mentioned once, never appears on the page.

adaptation_inventions: Mr. McGregor has a heart attack
Mr. McGregor's nephew inherits the garden
